title: Novis, PHP, Bun and Go compared end to end, measured by one command, shown on the website

stages.title: four peers behind one TLS proxy
stages.summary: Adds `bun nv bench-compare`, which brings up Novis, PHP-FPM, Bun and Go one at a time behind the same TLS-terminating nginx on the same CPU budget, and records requests per second, latency and memory for each.

stages.title: the four cases
stages.summary: Writes hello, json-api, html-page and wait for all four peers, checked to answer alike before any timing.

stages.title: the Novis fact the table needs and nothing tests
stages.summary: Adds the end-to-end test that one request's statics are not seen by the next under `nvs serve`.

stages.title: the feature scenarios
stages.summary: Runs each feature row as a script against all four stacks and records what each one did, so the table is generated from results.

stages.title: the page
stages.summary: Copies the record to the website and adds the comparison page under In depth.

stages.title: the first recorded run
stages.summary: Takes the full run on this machine, records it in `benches/compare.json`, and renders it to the website.

checks.name: bench-compare: the peer table, the record shape and the agreement mapping
bench-compare --smoke: all four peers answer every case alike behind TLS
nvs-cli (a static set by one request is not seen by the next under nvs serve)
bench-compare --scenarios --smoke: every feature row runs against every peer
